summary: OnKure Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to amend its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering program under an S-3 registration statement, increasing the maximum offering amount to $100 million of Class A common stock. The filing updates eligibility under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3; no shares have been sold as of August 4, 2026. Leerink Partners acts as agent with up to 3.0% compensation. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM update, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer; there are no deal terms to report.
